Regression test for generic-methods.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags
-min_go=go1.27

-- settings.json --
{
	"hints": {
		"functionTypeParameters": true,
		"parameterNames": true
	}
}

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.27

-- generic_methods.go --
package genericmethods //@inlayhints(typeparams)

type S struct{}

func (S) Two[A, B any](a A, b B) {}

func (S) Three[A, B, C any](a A, b B, c C) {}

func main() {
    var s S
    s.Two(1, "s")
    s.Two[int](1, "s")
    s.Two[int, string](1, "s")
    s.Three[int](1, "s", true)
    s.Three[int, string](1, "s", true)
}

-- @typeparams --
package genericmethods //@inlayhints(typeparams)

type S struct{}

func (S) Two[A, B any](a A, b B) {}

func (S) Three[A, B, C any](a A, b B, c C) {}

func main() {
    var s S
    s.Two<[int, string]>(<a: >1, <b: >"s")
    s.Two[int<, string>](<a: >1, <b: >"s")
    s.Two[int, string](<a: >1, <b: >"s")
    s.Three[int<, string, bool>](<a: >1, <b: >"s", <c: >true)
    s.Three[int, string<, bool>](<a: >1, <b: >"s", <c: >true)
}
